Remove the CAT ONLY; leave the empty large foreground rug for the original animated cat to be composited. Do not show the other three panels. No typography whatsoever, no cats anywhere, no cat figurines.

Generate a standalone original illustration plate at high resolution, no screen border, no screenshot of a board.

concept:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a completely NEW, high-fidelity mobile UI system for 丸宠, an original cozy cat companion game. This output is a PROFESSIONAL FOUR-SCREEN INTERACTION DESIGN BOARD, not standalone interior concept art. Wide landscape 3:2 board, four equally large full-height portrait mobile screens aligned horizontally, thin warm-gray boundaries, no bulky device frames. Cream board with four small captions below each screen: 家园, 行囊, 旅途, 相册. Each mobile screen around 390:844 ratio and fully legible, carefully crafted Chinese typography.
User brief: Japanese HAND-DRAWN picture book game interface, fresh, simple, clean orderly but with adequate furniture, warm beige morning, breeze, soft sunlight. Completely rethink composition, UI hierarchy, navigation and panels. Preserve only the original calico cat identity from input image and core features. Do NOT use any existing UI or earlier room layout. The cat reference is the ONLY reference: preserve white face, orange left patch, dark gray right patch, friendly resting form.
STYLE: visibly hand-drawn softly wobbly warm-pencil linework, simple pale watercolor fills and very restrained texture. Clearly 2D illustrated, almost a charming pencil sketch colored by hand. NO photo, NO realistic interior rendering, NO individual wood/fabric fibers, NO shiny 3D, NO dense foliage. Large clear ivory surfaces for text, chestnut brown ink, muted sage actions, pale apricot small accents. Charming asymmetry in illustration, disciplined spacing in controls.

SCREEN 1 HOME: a designed playable home. Small top title “早安，小家” with small subtitle “阳光正好，风也轻轻。” and a subtle settings cog top-right. Main region occupies 75% of screen: an airy NEW CUTAWAY DIORAMA living room drawn from gently elevated 3/4 perspective, visible two walls meeting in back center, with window upper-left, desk and simple chair against back-left wall, bookcase and organized storage back-right, armchair left-middle, low oval coffee table right-middle, a travel backpack by right-hand door, and a broad pale oval rug in foreground with the reference cat prominently resting. Enough furniture, tidy and lived-in, easy-to-see open floor for walking. Window curtain gently sweeping inward, two broad sunny color shapes on floor. The room is a visual game space, not a cinematic photograph. Three small handwritten object labels attached subtly to real objects: “行囊” on backpack at right, “相册” on coffee table at left, “门口” beside door; no separate giant CTA region. A tiny grounded bottom caption “轻轻摸摸它，或在小屋里走走。” Minimal scene exit “去庭院” near door. ABSOLUTELY NO BOTTOM TAB BAR, no white navigation tray, no currency, no large hero heading. Home feels like looking into a gentle illustrated world.

SCREEN 2 BAG OVERLAY: the SAME home faintly visible above and around an inset oatmeal paper-and-linen panel occupying lower 72%, with a real close X at top right. Heading “带一点心意” and subcopy “挑选这次出门带上的物品”. A large simple hand-drawn open cloth bundle area with TWO selected travel items neatly arranged, small captions 食物 and 水壶, not a generic grid of rounded cards. Below, a clean two-column inventory selection with illustrated bento and water bottle, quantities “3 份” and “2 份”, one checked item with a tiny sage checkmark. A restrained summary “已装好 2 件 · 每种带 1 份” and ONE sage primary button “带好行囊，出发”. Secondary text “暂时收起”. Clear native readable text, subtle organic paper edge and linen tie illustration only at corners, ample spacing, no saturated orange buttons.

SCREEN 3 TRIP OVERLAY: the SAME home, cat absent and rug visible in upper part, a cream correspondence paper sheet opened in lower 68% with close X. A small hand-drawn postcard showing a calm woodland path, tasteful postage stamp corner, title “在路上，慢慢来” and destination “林间小路”. A simple unobtrusive illustrated path from 小屋 to 林间 with the travel stage marked, no big countdown. Clear status “正在旅行” and gentle text “小屋会一直为它留着。” Two actions “回到小屋” primary in sage and “查看旅途” small text. No urgent red dots or gamification clutter.

SCREEN 4 ALBUM OVERLAY: the SAME home faintly visible beyond the edges. An open cream scrapbook filling lower 80%, subtle fabric sage spine and pencil page edge. Heading “把小日子收起来” with close X. Tabs “明信片” and “纪念品” as paper index tabs, selected underlined sage. One large leading woodland postcard in off-white mount, readable caption “林间来信” and tiny date “10月22日”; below two smaller pale postcards of stream and meadow with captions “溪边” and “草地”. Gentle small text “3 段旅途，3 份回忆”. Clean composition not uniform dashboard tiles. Bottom text action “合上相册”. All Chinese text dark warm brown and crisp.

Design all four as one cohesive NEW interaction UI, with each entire screen visible uncropped. Surrounding game remains perceptible under overlays. This is a realistic review deliverable showing actual app screens, not a poster of furniture. The UI itself must dominate the design board and be genuinely redesigned with the scene.

A low wooden fence and garden gate at upper right opens to a pale winding path. Two organized raised planter beds, a few terracotta pots with herbs and white daisies, small watering can. Central lower half is an OPEN spacious pale cream stepping-stone patio with warm broad hand-painted sunlight shapes, reserved for the existing pet to be composited separately. Draw all objects with slightly irregular soft brown pencil contours, simplified friendly forms and shallow flat watercolor shading. Clearly visible hand linework, no individual wood fibers or realistic fabric grain. Group leaves into simple sage-green shapes, gentle pale blue sky. Palette cream, oat beige, light apricot wood, muted sage green with pale blue touches. Airy, tender, a complete pleasant courtyard with a modest amount of furnishings. Illustration must be much simpler and more graphic than a realistic render; no 3D, no photographs, no cinematic lighting, no texture overload, no vignette. Matching the reference drawing style precisely, not its exact indoor arrangement.
